title: 第1502章 强大的危机来临加更第1501章 被杀上门来
content_zh:
第1502章强大的危机来临（加更）
金色光团看似微弱，却蕴含着不可思议的净化与创造之力。它一接触到万魂幡，那无数怨魂便如冰雪遇骄阳般消融，漆黑的旗帜也开始寸寸碎裂。
“啊——！我的万魂幡！”万魂老魔发出一声凄厉的惨叫，显然遭受了重创。他没想到，一个刚出生的婴儿竟有如此力量！
“是你女儿？！”万魂老魔又惊又怒，“好！好！今日我便先杀了她！”残余的魔影凝聚成一道利爪，绕过秦延军，直扑庄园内的秦青。
“找死！”秦延军怒喝，他最在意的就是家人。混沌青莲全力催动，瞬间将那道魔影碾碎。
同时，他锁定了万魂老魔的真身所在，一步跨出，混沌拳意直接贯穿虚空。
“噗——”远在数万里之外的一座阴森山谷中，正在吐血疗伤的万魂老魔身体猛地一僵，随即炸成了一团血雾。
临死前，他眼中充满了恐惧和不解：“为何……一个婴儿……”
秦延军返回庄园，看着被奶娘安抚下来，正好奇地睁着大眼睛看他的秦青，心中涌起暖流。
女儿的特殊体质，果然非同凡响！这混沌青莲孕育出的孩子，天生便拥有混沌本源的部分威能，尤其克制这些阴邪之物。
接连解决了界主使者和魔道巨擘，秦延军并未放松警惕。他知道，最强大的敌人——混沌神族，来了！
远方的天际，空间扭曲，一道道充满蛮荒、霸道气息的身影降临。
为首者，是一位身材高大，面容古朴，眉心有着竖眼的男子，他是混沌神族的一位长老，实力深不可测，远超之前的天枢使和万魂老魔。
“混沌青莲，果然在此！”混沌神族长老眼中闪过贪婪的光芒，“此乃我混沌神族至宝，岂容尔等凡人染指！交出青莲，臣服我族，可留尔等全尸！”
他身后的数十名混沌神族战士，同时释放出恐怖的气息，那是属于混沌生灵的独特威压。
秦延军将秦青和庄园众人护在身后，混沌青莲悬浮头顶，战意升腾：“想要青莲，凭本事来拿！”
“不知死活！”混沌神族长老冷哼一声，眉心竖眼睁开，一道蕴含着破灭气息的混沌光束射向秦延军。
同时，他身后的混沌神族战士也发动了冲锋，各种混沌神通铺天盖地而来。
秦延军不敢怠慢，古神王境圆满的力量毫无保留地爆发，与混沌青莲的力量完美融合。
他一人一莲，如同一尊开天辟地的混沌神祇，硬撼混沌神族的攻击。

“轰！轰！轰！”
剧烈的碰撞在秦家庄园上空爆发，空间不断破碎又修复。秦延军以一敌众，竟丝毫不落下风。
混沌青莲的防御无懈可击，攻击更是霸道绝伦，每一次挥动，都有混沌神族战士被湮灭。
激战中，秦青再次有了反应。她似乎感受到了同源的混沌气息，但这气息中充满了暴虐和贪婪，让她很不舒服。
她小手挥舞，口中发出咿咿呀呀的声音，一道道更加精纯的混沌本源之力从她身上散发出来，融入秦延军体内。
得到“女儿”力量的加持，秦延军的气息更加磅礴，他仰天长啸，一拳轰碎了混沌神族长老的竖眼光束，顺势将其震退。
“怎么可能？你竟能引动如此精纯的混沌本源？”混沌神族长老又惊又怒，他感觉到秦延军的力量似乎无穷无尽，而且他身上的混沌气息，比他们这些所谓的混沌神族还要纯正！

Chapter 1502 A powerful crisis is coming (additional update)
The golden light group seems weak, but it contains incredible power of purification and creation. As soon as it came into contact with the Ten Thousand Souls Flag, the countless resentful souls melted like ice and snow meeting the scorching sun, and the pitch-black flag began to shatter inch by inch.
"Ah——! My Ten Thousand Souls Banner!" The Ten Thousand Souls Old Demon let out a shrill scream, obviously suffering heavy injuries. He didn't expect that a newborn baby could have such power!
"It's your daughter?!" Wanhun Old Demon was shocked and angry, "Okay! Okay! I'll kill her first today!" The remaining demonic shadow condensed into a sharp claw, bypassing Qin Yanjun, and went straight to Qin Qing in the manor.
"Seeking death!" Qin Yanjun shouted angrily. What he cared about most was his family. The Chaos Qinglian used all its strength to instantly crush the demonic shadow.
At the same time, he locked onto the real body of the Wanhun Old Demon, took a step forward, and penetrated the void with his chaotic fist.
"Poof -" In a gloomy valley tens of thousands of miles away, the body of Wanhun Old Demon, who was vomiting blood to heal his wounds, stiffened suddenly and then exploded into a ball of blood mist.
Before he died, his eyes were full of fear and confusion: "Why...a baby..."
Qin Yanjun returned to the manor and saw Qin Qing, who was comforted by the nanny and looking at him with big eyes curiously, feeling warm in his heart.
My daughter’s special physique is indeed extraordinary! The children born from this Chaos Green Lotus are born with some of the power of the Chaos Origin, especially to restrain these evil things.
Qin Yanjun did not relax his vigilance after successively defeating the envoys of the Realm Lord and the giants of the Demonic Way. He knew that the most powerful enemy, the Chaos Gods, was coming!
In the distant sky, the space is distorted, and figures full of wild and domineering auras descend.
The leader is a tall man with a simple face and vertical eyes between his eyebrows. He is an elder of the Chaos God Clan. His strength is unfathomable and far surpasses the previous Tianshu Angel and Ten Thousand Souls Old Demon.
"The Chaos Green Lotus is indeed here!" A greedy light flashed in the eyes of the elder of the Chaos God Clan, "This is the most precious treasure of our Chaos God Clan, how can we allow mortals like you to get involved in it! Hand over the Green Lotus, surrender to our clan, and keep your corpses intact!"
Dozens of Chaos God Clan warriors behind him simultaneously released a terrifying aura, which was the unique coercion of chaotic creatures.
Qin Yanjun protected Qin Qing and everyone in the manor behind him. Chaos Qinglian floated above his head, and his fighting spirit rose: "If you want Qinglian, get it with your ability!"
"I don't know whether to live or die!" The elder of the Chaos God Clan snorted coldly, opened his eyebrows, and shot a chaotic beam of light containing the aura of destruction towards Qin Yanjun.
At the same time, the Chaos God Clan warriors behind him also launched a charge, and all kinds of chaotic magical powers came overwhelmingly.
Qin Yanjun did not dare to neglect, and the perfect power of the ancient god king realm exploded without reservation, perfectly integrating with the power of the Chaos Qinglian.
He is one person and one lotus, like a Chaos God who created the world, resisting the attacks of the Chaos Gods.
"Boom! Boom! Boom!"
A violent collision broke out over the Qin family manor, and the space was constantly broken and repaired. Qin Yan's army was defeated by one, but it was not at a disadvantage.
Chaos Qinglian's defense is impeccable, and its attacks are even more domineering. Every time it swings, Chaos God Clan warriors are annihilated.
During the fierce battle, Qin Qing reacted again. She seemed to feel the chaotic aura from the same source, but this aura was full of violence and greed, which made her very uncomfortable.
She waved her little hands and made babbling sounds from her mouth, and streams of more pure power of chaos emanated from her body and merged into Qin Yanjun's body.
With the blessing of the power of his "daughter", Qin Yanjun's aura became even more majestic. He looked up to the sky and roared, shattering the vertical eye beam of the Chaos God Clan elder with one punch and knocking him back.
"How is it possible? You can actually activate such a pure source of chaos?" The elder of the Chaos God Clan was shocked and angry. He felt that Qin Yanjun's power seemed to be endless, and the aura of chaos in his body was stronger than those of their so-calledThe Chaos Gods must be pure!
